name: Reddit
description: Search selected subreddits or all public Reddit.
scopeNote: Posts and comments share the result limit. Relative time filters apply to posts; custom dates collect newer posts or thread comments. At least 10 results must be requested.
capabilityNote: Subreddits, relative dates, earliest dates, comments, media links and post sorting.

name: X / Twitter
description: Search topics, specific accounts, or conversation threads.
scopeNote: Uses X search with account, date, reply and media filters. Dates include the whole UTC day. Search coverage and repost availability depend on X.
capabilityNote: Accounts, inclusive date range, replies, conversation threads, reposts and media.

name: LinkedIn search
description: Discover LinkedIn posts about a topic.
scopeNote: Keyword search with an optional earliest date. Comments, liked-user details and document details are optional; availability depends on the Actor and LinkedIn.
capabilityNote: Keyword search, earliest date, comments, liked-user details and attached documents.

name: LinkedIn accounts
description: Collect posts from selected people and companies.
scopeNote: Collects account posts, with optional comments and reactions billed as additional rows. Topic text is research context, not a keyword filter. The post allowance is shared evenly across accounts.
capabilityNote: Profiles and companies, relative or earliest date, comments, reactions, quote posts and reposts.
